eligibility_text: The annual family income should be less than or equal to RS.2.5 lakh. Applicant must belong to the OBC category. Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra. Applicant must be pursuing a professional course approved by the government. If the applicant fails in any academic year, she will receive benefits only for that year, but not for the subsequent year until she is promoted to the next class. Admission must be taken through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for professional courses. Scholarship is allowed for all girl applicants, whereas a maximum of two boys from the same family can avail the scheme. If the applicant accepts another scholarship or stipend, she will be ineligible under this scheme from that date. Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory for the current academic year. A girl applicant will remain eligible if she changes her course from Non-Professional to Professional. However, changing from Professional to Non-Professional makes her ineligible. If the applicant changes her professional course during the academic year after availing benefits, she will not be eligible for further benefits.

renewal_requirements: The applicant must pass the previous year’s examination. In case of failure, no reimbursement will be paid for that year. Group A Courses: If the applicant fails for the first time, the scholarship may be renewed. For subsequent failures, the applicant must bear her own expenses until promoted. Group B, C, D, E Courses: The applicant must be promoted to the next class to continue receiving benefits. Subsequent failures will not be reimbursed.
